answer: Forge each agent identity by bonding stake that is slashed when the same key signs contradictory work, so spinning up many fake identities gets expensive fast. A public thread of signed attestations links every job to its bond, letting peers check history before trusting a newcomer. Reputation then grows like a knoll, slowly and only through verified useful work, so a Sybil swarm cannot buy instant trust and its cost rises with every fake it spawns.
